title: Platform backend modules, processors and stores
caption: NestJS modules of the API process (layers 0-4), the worker's processors, and the stores and queues they use. Click a node for its folder and job.

nodes.label: Portal / admin servers
nodes.detail: Call `/v1/**` with Bearer tokens and the PADR-0019 BFF headers.

nodes.label: Caddy
nodes.detail: Forwards `/webhooks/*` and calls `/internal/tls/ask` on loopback.

nodes.label: Request pipeline
nodes.detail: `common/`: request context (nestjs-cls), Redis throttler, `PortalAuthGuard` / `AdminAuthGuard` / `InternalOnlyGuard` / `StripeSignatureGuard`, `MfaEnrolmentGuard`, `TenantRoleGuard`, `FeatureGuard`, `RecentMfaGuard`, Ajv OpenAPI validation, idempotency, error filter.

nodes.label: Auth + Accounts
nodes.detail: `auth/`, `accounts/`: sign-up, verify, sign-in, MFA challenge, refresh, password reset, step-up, `me`, MFA set-up, sessions.

nodes.label: Tenants + Provisioning
nodes.detail: `tenants/`, `provisioning/`: key availability, create OTA, setup progress, retry, reveal keys, onboarding, go-live, suspend/resume/migrate.

nodes.label: Memberships
nodes.detail: `memberships/`: members, roles, invitations, console token (`ptk:`).

nodes.label: API keys
nodes.detail: `api-keys/`: create, rename/origins, roll, revoke; HMAC with the pepper.

nodes.label: Domains + TLS ask
nodes.detail: `domains/`: sub-domain, custom domains, checks, primary, `tlsAsk`.

nodes.label: Connections
nodes.detail: `supplier-connections/`, `payment-connections/`, `common/credentials/`: Amadeus pool and connections, Stripe Connect / API keys / Velexis mode, credential submissions.

nodes.label: Billing + BillingSync
nodes.detail: `billing/`: plans, subscriptions, Checkout, Customer Portal, invoices; `billing/sync/`: webhook receiver.

nodes.label: Settlements
nodes.detail: `settlements/`: payout accounts, statements, CSV.

nodes.label: AdminModule
nodes.detail: `admin/`: thin controllers for every `/v1/admin/**` route, dashboard, queue inspector, admin CLI.

nodes.label: Audit + Notifications
nodes.detail: `audit/` (`platform_audit_log` in the caller's transaction), `notifications/` (outbox in the caller's transaction).

nodes.label: tenant-events processor
nodes.detail: `provisioning/tenant-events.processor.ts`: post-steps, failure handler, migrate/suspend/resume answers.

nodes.label: email processor
nodes.detail: `notifications/email.processor.ts`: `email.send`, `email.sweep` (every minute).

nodes.label: stripe-events processor
nodes.detail: `billing/sync/stripe-events.processor.ts`: re-fetch, handlers, status rules; Connect account events.

nodes.label: domain-checks processor
nodes.detail: `domains/domain-checks.processor.ts`: `domain.verify`, `domain.recheck`, `domain.tls_probe`.

nodes.label: verification processor
nodes.detail: `supplier-connections/verification.processor.ts`: `amadeus_account.verify`, `credentials.verify`, `credentials.sweep`.

nodes.label: settlements processor
nodes.detail: `settlements/settlements.processor.ts`: `settlement.generate`.

nodes.label: maintenance processor
nodes.detail: `common/queues/maintenance.processor.ts`: runs every `@MaintenanceJob` schedule of `scheduler.registry.ts`.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL platform + reference
nodes.detail: Role `velexis_platform_app`; no access to tenant schemas.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.detail: BullMQ prefix `vx`; keys of `common/redis/redis-keys.ts`; channel `vx:invalidate`.

nodes.label: ota-tenant-ops
nodes.detail: Produced here, consumed by the OTA worker.

nodes.label: platform-* queues (7)
nodes.detail: `platform-tenant-events`, `platform-emails`, `platform-stripe-events`, `platform-domains`, `platform-connections`, `platform-settlements`, `platform-maintenance`.

nodes.label: OTA worker / OTA API
nodes.detail: Provision/migrate/suspend/resume tenant schemas; reads platform tables.

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.detail: Velexis account; pinned `apiVersion`, idempotency keys, 10 s timeout.

nodes.label: Amadeus OAuth
nodes.detail: `POST {baseUrl}/v1/security/oauth2/token`, token discarded.

nodes.label: SMTP / DNS
nodes.detail: Nodemailer to `SMTP_URL`; `node:dns` Resolver on `DNS_RESOLVERS`.
